description: This Java class 'CloseShareAccountCommandHandler' handles the command to close a share account in the FinERP system. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the closing operation to 'ShareAccountWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated with Spring's @Service and uses dependency injection for the service.

classes.name: CloseShareAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles 'CLOSE' command for share accounts, invoking the service to close accounts process.

methods.name: CloseShareAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor for dependency injection of ShareAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to close a share account by delegating to the write platform service.
